notes.title: Ready to Hustle? This Update Means Business!
notes.content:

Open the Careers app to buy in, earn passive income, and make key decisions to keep things running smoothly.
[/p][p]Once you've reached the highest rank in a job, you can also work anytime without selecting a shift, which will also boost the store's rating. [/p][p]

notes.title: Update 0.28.0 - New Job Alert + More Cool Stuff!
notes.content:
[h2]Computer Technician Job 🖥️[/h2]
Repair and upgrade PCs for clients at the new computer shop! Apply for the job using the Jobs smartphone app.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/88ab96f2692ea055898e965906af97eb5f17c079.png[/img]

[h2]Hair Salon 💈[/h2]
Refresh your look at the brand-new Hair Salon! Featuring a variety of trendy hairstyles and your choice of color.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/850bab71e9924db0958749f45f2e625bf9b2055d.png[/img]

[h2]Downtown Medical Clinic 🏥[/h2]
Visit the brand-new Downtown Medical Clinic! Choose from a range of specialized medications and treatments to boost your health and happiness. Try the all-new sleeping pills, perfect for helping you rest comfortably and pass time faster in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/bd1b98e8c1b79da119621b59623f93cc512b4321.png[/img]

[h2]Taxi Service 🚕[/h2]
Traveling around town is now easier than ever! With the brand-new Taxi app, you can hail a ride to any destination. Simply pick your spot from the list and get moving. No car required!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/ca4e7cc8c4ba0efa68c62c7e7f06eb9b8457c3f4.png[/img]

[h2]Map Improvements 🗺️[/h2]
Zoom and scroll functionality has been added to the map for smoother navigation, along with an updated player icon that's easier to spot at a glance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/7c156630f10b563536f1ba1cb3478f37affed729.png[/img]

[h2]Other new content[/h2]
New achievements have been added, as well as several other changes and fixes. Check out the full changelist below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/a67b2b630399717fe26c1b2f077880702ffc8c9d.png[/img]

[h2]Changelist[/h2]
• Added computer technician job
• Added hair salon and new hairstyles
• Added downtown medical clinic
• Added sleeping pills to medical clinic
• Added zoom and scroll functionality to map, improved player visibility, UI revisions
• Added new achievements
• Updated cursor graphics
• Fixed real estate offers unable to be declined
• Fixed mouse smoothing sometimes enabling when disabled
• Fixed some terrain objects opening interaction UI
• Fixed some missing collision issues
• Fixed player icon sometimes appearing in incorrect location on map
• Fixed some character UI hair rendering issues
• Fixed some issues with input context panel logic
• Fixed some interior volumetric light banding issues

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
Exciting times ahead for Denizen! Plenty of new content is already in development, with much more planned throughout 2025 and beyond.

The next content update will introduce a third-person camera mode, a brand-new business management feature, and more!

Thank you for playing Denizen and for providing your valuable feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Update 0.27.0 - Socializing, Supercars, and More!
notes.content:
[h2]Social 👨🏽‍🤝‍👩🏻[/h2]
Enhanced interaction options, improved gameplay logic, and new cinematics have been added to make the social experience more engaging and immersive than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/df7524a1ac9d7517691917abc3b40faaf742bbe3.png[/img]

Two new friends have been added to the Social smartphone app. Complete Sandy's mission to unlock her as a contact and expand your circle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/5f82356a8f699560c1e34bca5e7aa653330a6d8c.png[/img]

[h2]Ferrucci Supercar Dealership 🏎️🏁[/h2]
Explore the new Ferrucci showroom downtown, carrying high-performance supercars available in a range of exotic colors. Take your pick and hit the streets in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/64d1bd987545813c0383443fec55383743da8964.png[/img]

[h2]Texas Hold'em Poker ♠️♦️♣️♥️ [/h2]
Head over to the Shores Casino and test your skills in the new Texas Hold'em poker game. Play wisely and walk away with a stack of extra cash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/8f117747e30b17ce9cf876b908cb1cfea44d6caf.png[/img]

[h2]Minimap 🗺️[/h2]
At last, the minimap is here! It displays key locations and mission markers, helping with navigation around the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/5cb4e1e524cf1e551baa8112976cd312d3dffac2.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.26.0 - Play, Earn, and Win Big!
notes.content:
[h2]Play, Earn, and Win Big![/h2]
Play casino games while earning points to unlock exclusive rewards. Redeem your points for free hotel stays and a chance to spin the Lucky Wheel for cash prizes! Keep track of your progress with the Shores Casino mobile site.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/82a87277b2df33d2d100e50187523d1b8f07e42c.png[/img]

[h2]Hotel[/h2]
Unwind in a premium hotel room at the Shores Casino. Reserve your stay with cash or points and enjoy a comfortable retreat after a night of gaming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/b2c5039011a51127545c51c4c75c4ab7eab1b1e1.png[/img]

[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
Check out the beefy Titan 440, now available at Cutler Used Autos. Also now available is the trusty Fuji Commando pickup truck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/34354ca503c4b90225c04a8b35b2a931dcc3e39c.png[/img]

[h2]Hood Camera[/h2]
A new camera option has been added to all vehicles for a new perspective. Just use the C key to toggle between camera views while driving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d732ecccb7f6c29f25be089aa70e21abf3e5563e.png[/img]

[h2]Christmas Tree🎄[/h2]
Visit the furniture store and bring home a festive Christmas tree, perfect for the season! The tree comes decorated with ornaments and glowing lights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/7c729aa7e6ae6e038d53d1e7ef1c84177c20c364.png[/img]

• And more!

notes.title: Update 0.24.0 - New Opportunities Await!
notes.content:
[h2]Narcotic Production[/h2]
Capitalize on the opportunity to acquire specialized equipment and ingredients to launch and grow a narcotic production operation in the competitive market!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/44596560968430b9a10de9da75ae9ef6543b0b5a.png[/img]

Use the new Black Market website on your smartphone to conveniently order equipment and ingredients, with discreet courier delivery right to your doorstep.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/8fa533064220093092b154d8fb73cf8734770a58.png[/img]

[h2]Retail[/h2]
You can now stock your retail shops by ordering inventory directly from the new MegaMerch website. Simply add your desired merchandise to the cart, choose your preferred shipping method, and your products will be on their way to your store in no time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d86708b102ea5badcbb996676b553a705388cef1.png[/img]

For those who prefer a more hands-on approach, a new cargo vehicle has just been added to the used car dealership!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/0ff03ec120f858c61c32beefcbb9e2e7286a5375.png[/img]

The inventory loading interface has also been improved with a condensed transfer list, so you can now select the number of units or transfer all inventory matching the store type. Logic has also been added to prevent loading merchandise that doesn't match the store type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e6efb484b1bead8d58a5ce6a54b8049f14f16493.png[/img]

[h2]Courier[/h2]
A new courier location in town provides a secure service for shipping your products, ensuring complete confidentiality for you and your clients!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/51057ab70aa243dfdb40e6a997a2e104ff9b3bf3.png[/img]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
Be sure to check out the new Statistics app on the smartphone, where you can track your in-game progress! There have also been some new achievements added, and several more additions and changes listed in the changelog below:

notes.title: Update 0.23.0 - Party Time!
notes.content:
[h2]Missions[/h2]
Head over to Vault Nightclub and meet with the club manager, who has new missions waiting for you. Get ready for some investigative work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/276a87a3159807b348765c3f75be590452491a08.png[/img]

notes.content:
[h2]Racing[/h2]
Experience the thrill of speed at the newly opened Cedar Shores Drag Strip! Test your skills and push your limits on the new track. After gearing up your vehicle, place a wager with a rival of your choice and get ready to enjoy the action and maybe make some money!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/fdd9c8229ab04ace785407abd322ecd1ec60798b.png[/img]

Check out the new tuner in town, designed to take your driving experience to the next level. Upgrade your vehicle with top-of-the-line options, including powerful turbochargers, nitrous, and advanced braking systems. Customize your ride to achieve peak performance and dominate the local track!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/2cfbc1b2beeb7773273aadd5a2d35e316c49bb7b.png[/img]

[h2]Other new features[/h2]
The Assets app now features a more comprehensive overview of your vehicles. You can now use the app to sell your vehicles. Just select a vehicle, add it to the market, and wait for offers to come in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/5a1a0a1ced5eb22fe2eba45fee971af9053f2b30.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access preview
notes.content:
Denizen is almost here. Let's take a closer look at some of the features that will be included in the initial Early Access release!

[h2]Properties[/h2]
Denizen features a variety of homes to choose from that can each be customized to your liking. Each home is designed with a unique layout and characteristics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d31c96c7d446bca548706c34a0402681c35ce0b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Retail[/h2]
The retail business feature was a popular addition to the pre-release build and has been further developed for the Early Access build.

You will have the option to rent out additional stores with varying inventory capacities and customer traffic. New product types have also been added to the warehouse.

Also, a new cargo truck is available that's great for hauling all that merchandise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/43d61f5c0c616721487d74f1e1be585aa35d3b4c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Social[/h2]
A key feature of Denizen is the Social feature which will be built upon in future updates of the game.

Use your smartphone to meet new friends by chatting through the Social app. After making friends, you can invite them over to your home to hang out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/6b8fc0debbf5011724a09d019e1f62bba060d5a9.png[/img]

[h2]Shores Casino[/h2]
Head out to the east side of the city for some entertainment at the Shores Casino. Choose from a variety of games to play including slots and table games. In a future update during Early Access, you'll also be able to spend the night at the hotel which features a selection of premium rooms to stay in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/b4055bc23821e12d3f62c7412292bb8692cd5d4c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Car Dealerships[/h2]
Vehicles are an integral part of Denizen, and you can pick the perfect vehicle to make your way around the city by visiting one of several dealerships that offer a range of automobiles to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e1f2f3285eb487a7c6abb2fe75b51c263d094492.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other content[/h2]
• Expanded map
• New jobs
• New missions
• Furniture store
• Clothing store
• Nightclub
• City NPC interaction
• Revised traffic system
• And much more!

[h2]Thank you[/h2]
The community has been hugely supportive and helpful during the demo run. Thank you for your feedback and support!

There is much more to come for Denizen, and community feedback will be essential for shaping its future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010030/Denizen/

notes.title: Demo update 0.17.0
notes.content:
[h2]0.17.0[/h2]
The 1.17.0 demo update is now live with additional content and improvements. Check out the latest new features!

[h2]Vehicles and car wash[/h2]
Improvements have been made to vehicle physics, audio, and NPC traffic. There has also been another vehicle added to the used car dealership.

Vehicles now accumulate dirt while they are driven off-road, so of course a car wash had to be added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e1aaa5d90aa6aac0e2b35151b2d832100fca6c36.png[/img]

[h2]Smartphone apps[/h2]
New apps have been added to the smartphone:

• Assets app: This app allows you to sell and rent out your owned properties. You can also view a list of your owned vehicles. More to come with this app in a future build.

• Utilities app: The Utilities app tracks the daily electric and water bills for your properties. The amounts for these bills are withdrawn from your account at the end of each day.

• Maps app: A map has been added to the phone for easier navigation around the city.

Also, the original three property apps have been condensed into one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/7048cc2fa5863a0e00385d5123670e0dae6b9928.png[/img]

[h2]Residence customization[/h2]
When purchasing paint for your home, you now have the option to customize the color as well as select the type of finish you want.

New furniture and electronics have been added. Play custom videos on the TV, or try playing your own music with the music player. Make sure to check out the new customizable light fixtures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/ee84179a088c483cd105a18d904b8d9c980fb224.png[/img]

[h2]New house[/h2]
Another house has been added to the market. This residence includes a garage for vehicle storage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/f53b85ebfc00e2e75daa5f3b8d576a057684d85b.png[/img]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
Environment art has received an overhaul that focuses on foliage and lighting improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/89fe8a0c7136445e0e0c18e22ddfb4037da10e31.png[/img]

[h2]Other content[/h2]
Loads of other fixes and revisions have also been included in this update. If you do encounter any issues, please feel welcome to report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2010030/discussions/]community forums[/url]!

[h2]Release date[/h2]
A release date of Q1 2024 is now public on the Denizen store page. Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback!

There are some exciting content previews on the way that offer a peek into what the Early Access version will offer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010030/Denizen/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/afcf4b8e78659c36962d02b7a3a5286ae2b29e71.png[/img]

[h2]Forklift[/h2]
As part of the new mission, you can try out the new forklift vehicle. In the Early Access release of Denizen, you can work as a forklift operator in a larger warehouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d21f03a71d3cefcff763b0604f0a415452c125b7.png[/img]

[h2]Body shop[/h2]
You can now take your car to the local body shop for repair, paint, and window tint. Paint your car in any color you like with a solid, metallic, or matte finish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/3bf7b25f78256ee6c6736bdf81b16a8cf02a083f.png[/img]

[h2]Used car dealership[/h2]
The used car dealership is in business! Stop by and pick from a selection of used automobiles. In the Early Access release of Denizen, there will be several additional dealerships to visit in the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/9bb5dfeb9ee79e57e34496eb6645132856dd4fe6.png[/img]

[h2]Hacking and lockpicking[/h2]
Hacking and lockpicking minigames have been added. These minigames are used in some missions and other parts of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/496a1511fefb6c5be9bfccb5f32ce2becc61a46d.png[/img]

[h2]Break-ins and looting[/h2]
Some buildings in the demo environment can now be broken into and looted using lockpicks acquired from the pawn shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e333b6ef657b421cd52e863b3c64601138dd6701.png[/img]

[h2]Radio stations[/h2]
Radio stations have been added to vehicles. These will be built upon in future updates to add commercials, hosted intermissions, and more music.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/0a760f65fdbad2500f75dec46a5d1cc4f983a8ca.png[/img]

[h2]Interaction states[/h2]
The state of light switches, doors, and some other entities in residences now persists through saving and loading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e107a27cf6a9dbb7c6c5c774436bc6bf61af370e.png[/img]

[h2]Other content[/h2]
Loads of fixes and improvements have also been included in this update to improve playability. If you do encounter any issues, please feel welcome to report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2010030/discussions/]community forums[/url]!

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
Work continues on the Early Access version of Denizen. More news on that soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010030/Denizen/

Another demo update! This update adds new features and fixes to the demo while development of the Early Access version of Denizen continues.

Road traffic has been added! There have also been major revisions to the pedestrian AI logic and physics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/ee960bb99e930b781afd3f5497b218f57ea91483.png[/img]

[h2]Other content[/h2]
Many other fixes and tweaks have been made, including:

• Improved performance
• Revised shaders and materials
• Revised vegetation
• Revised input and interaction logic
• Various other bug fixes and improvements

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
Development of the next update is already underway and is planned to include a major overhaul of the quest system as well as other new features and content.

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
[h2]0.11.0[/h2]
The 0.11.0 demo update is now available! This update includes new content in addition to many refinements to gameplay and visuals listed below. As development of the Early Access version of Denizen continues, there will be further updates to the playable demo.

[h2]Retail[/h2]
The new retail feature has been added which allows you to rent a property and open your own business. Stock up on wholesale consumer goods from the local warehouse and manage your store to maximize profits. To access this new feature, simply press the "R" key to open the new retail management interface.

In the Early Access version of Denizen, there will be additional stores to rent, each with a unique design, product inventory capacities, and customer traffic. This means you can create your own stores to fit your choice of brand and shopping experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/f313384602b37bf23a10da6ee4c741f9bddaa579.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/0b6973f45ee945c357454c537a9a65ecb3a313af.png[/img]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
Lighting and graphics have undergone a significant overhaul to enhance the overall visual experience, while the rural city environment has been given more character through a complete revamp. Continued progress has been made on the rest of the game map, including the downtown district that will be accessible in the Early Access release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/46561e3623242e3543d3101b011eb55f62c196b5.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/7cb56403a2bc13d4330bdd5dd8e1e742a6fc1990.png[/img]

[h2]Bar[/h2]
Stop by the new local bar to unwind after a long day of work. Have a drink and try your luck at the blackjack table!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d2bdd76ccf5d060dbd9e9c45b56789a8b5219618.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d978c35bd93fed3493b0f64f6ca8bbda842cee27.png[/img]

[h2]Other content[/h2]
The new clinic location offers a selection of medications and medical operations to help you manage your needs. Fuel consumption has been added to vehicles, in addition to a speedometer and fuel gauge. You can now refuel your car at the gas station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/38178bccb9aa3d5c7180e8ad2eaa5a6e23e85ddd.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/33fd3450ffd6432defb739a66cff4f175e72e234.png[/img]

There have also been many bug fixes and tweaks made in this update. A character creation feature was introduced in a recent unannounced update as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/c85a76fb64d802e2904b8929e3ca704f56881857.png[/img]

[h2]More to come![/h2]
Thank you for playing Denizen, and please visit the discussion forums to leave any feedback or suggestions you may have!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010030/Denizen/
